PORT.description: Port Kanboard listens on (default: 80). Railway injects PORT for routing.

DB_DRIVER.description: Database driver: sqlite, mysql, or postgres. SQLite is built-in with a persistent volume.

PLUGIN_INSTALLER.description: Set to true to enable the plugin installer from Administration > Plugins.

MAIL_FROM.description: From address for email notifications (task assignments, reminders). Change if you configure SMTP.

DEBUG.description: Set to true to enable debug mode for troubleshooting.
